## Current site decision

The owner requested a mature developer-product website close to Grafana's visual style while preserving the existing AgentSight route structure. The implementation uses Grafana only as a high-level reference for a dark product hero, direct product language, strong product imagery, open-source positioning, and clear calls to action. No Grafana code, artwork, brand asset, or page copy is copied.

The current cycle deliberately does not:

- add or remove public routes;
- change canonical ownership;
- migrate documentation content;
- add pricing, login, customer logos, testimonials, or invented usage numbers;
- add a repository scheduler, model-running workflow, webhook runner, provider SDK, or model credential;
- change the existing GA4 privacy and path-only configuration.
